name: Kizumono no Gakuen
source:
The day after the cultural festival is interrupted by a certain accident. Storm of bullets runs through the student conference, and school turns into one big battle royale. It's time for violence.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/03/vn-of-month-august-2001-kimi-ga-nozomu.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
文化祭因某场事故中断后的第二天，弹雨席卷学生大会，整所学校化为一场巨大的大逃杀。暴力时刻已经到来。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/03/vn-of-month-august-2001-kimi-ga-nozomu.html]vndbreview[/url]]
